I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I confirmed the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 84 seats and suggested he also correct his earlier post in #central-team.

One mistake in that reply: I said his #central-team post "still shows the old number", but I hadn't actually checked that channel. It's probably true, since he said he posted the wrong figure there this morning, but I didn't verify it. Nothing else was needed: a seat count isn't a finance figure, so no approval applies.
